name: Personal email review and action list (demo)
description: Synthetic demonstration of a read-only daily inbox review that separates deterministic mailbox organization from conditional AI-assisted summarization, action extraction, and reply drafting.
processNode: Daily review of new and unresolved email before the mailbox owner decides what to handle next.
decisionOrAction: Decide which email threads require attention, identify the next action and deadline, and optionally prepare a reply draft without changing mailbox state or sending a message.

metrics.name: Missed actionable email rate
metrics.definition: Share of email threads later found to require a reply or task but not identified during the agreed review window.
metrics.target: proposed:reduce after a user-accepted shadow period

metrics.name: Daily inbox review time
metrics.definition: Elapsed active time the user spends reviewing new and unresolved email during the daily review.
metrics.target: proposed:reduce without increasing missed actionable email

ontologyReferences.purpose: Proposed definitions for message, thread, correspondent, review status, action, deadline, evidence reference, summary, and reply draft.

sourceReferences.purpose: Read-only message and thread metadata and content explicitly permitted by the mailbox owner, with provider identity, retrieval time, and access decision.
User-recorded attention, action, correction, rejection, and completion reasons used to evaluate and improve the workflow.

acceptanceCriteria: Every review item identifies the source thread, retrieval time, semantic-definition version, and access decision.

The first slice keeps mailbox access read-only; any stored user decision uses a separately authorized, auditable, idempotent, and removable decision record without sending, deleting, archiving, unsubscribing, or changing mailbox state.
Any later AI summary, extracted action, deadline, or reply draft cites its source messages and abstains or asks for review when evidence is missing, conflicting, or sensitive.
Expansion beyond shadow use requires replay evidence showing incremental value over the deterministic baseline and explicit acceptance by the mailbox owner.
notes: This record is proposed and synthetic. Real mailbox access, privacy choices, baseline, source authority, access decision, thresholds, and acceptance evidence are missing.
